title: One universal skeleton, many projected appearances
plainLanguage: A shoulder is always the same anatomical shoulder even when it looks very different from another angle. The skeleton names the body consistently; the library records how that same structure appears in each picture.
purpose: Preserve one anatomical language across mannequin videos, future characters, and the still doll rig.

rules.statement: Use the existing universal-skeleton v1.2.0 IDs as the default anatomical names.
Anatomical left/right follows the subject, never screen-left/right.
Do not create a new skeleton merely because a view or character looks different; first test whether the difference is projection, artwork, or a genuine schema gap.
When a schema gap is suspected, preserve the old records and add a versioned extension or migration path rather than rewriting history.

implementation.currentSupport: Universal skeleton v1.2.0 already exists and is used by Corpus Pane.
implementation.futureWork: Use it as the stable semantic bridge into the still mannequin and future character families.
